title: CYBRIK model inference error v1
description: Provider-neutral typed error for an inference that produced NO result (the runtime failed, was unavailable, exceeded a budget, or the redaction/policy gate denied it). Distinct from cybrik.model-inference-result.v1 refusal/filtered outcomes, which are successful runtime responses. Fail-closed: message_safe is a sanitized, secret-free string (no stack traces, prompts, credentials, or runtime-native error blobs); an unmapped runtime failure surfaces as error_class 'internal' with retryable=false. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA).

request_id.description: Echoes the request's request_id for correlation.

tenant_id.description: Control-written authoritative tenant. Never populated from model output.

model_class.description: The requested class, if it resolved far enough to be known. Omitted for error_class 'model_class_unresolved'.

retryable.description: Whether an identical retry MIGHT succeed. Fail-closed default reasoning: budget/policy/redaction/context errors are retryable=false; only transient capacity/availability/timeout are retryable=true.

message_safe.description: Sanitized, human-readable message. MUST NOT contain secrets, credentials, raw prompts/inputs, model output, or runtime-native error payloads.

retry_after_seconds.description: Optional backoff hint; meaningful only when retryable=true.
